caption: The drawing shows a single ornate object resembling a decorative finial or furniture leg, rendered in black and white. The object is vertically oriented and consists of several distinct sections with intricate details. The top features a pinecone-shaped finial. Below this is a bulbous section with a swirl or spiral design, which transitions into a rounded form decorated with raised, rounded patterns and vertical bands. The base of the object consists of three legs, each curving outward and downward, terminating in paw-like feet. On the central lower portion between the legs is a rectangular segment decorated with a rosette or sunburst design. The entire drawing is monochromatic, utilizing various shades of grey to create depth and texture, with soft shading used to show form and contour against an off-white background. The artist’s signature is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Fire Dog
